claims.title: OpenVLA fine-tuned reaches 76.5% average success on LIBERO
claims.claim: OpenVLA fine-tuned per suite scores 84.7% (Spatial), 88.4% (Object), 79.2% (Goal), 53.7% (Long), 76.5% average, as a mean over 3 seeds.
claims.summary: Third-party runs land close on some suites and far off on others. One user's single-trial run averaged 73.75% (Goal 74.2, Long 48.4). A separate single-seed, 100-rollout-per-suite run using the official checkpoints averaged 67.0%, with Object at 60.0% against 88.4% reported, while Long (53.0%) and Goal (77.0%) were near the reported numbers. Neither run is a full 3-seed, 50-episode replication, so differences may be noise, hardware or rendering. Not enough to call the claim wrong.

evidence.label: lz-googlefycy/openvla-libero: official checkpoints, 100 rollouts per suite, 67.0% average

claims.checked_by: Claim Ledger agent, reviewed against the cited pages

claims.title: LeRobot reproduces Pi0.5 LIBERO results (97.5% average)
claims.claim: LeRobot's lerobot/pi05_libero_finetuned checkpoint reproduces published Pi0.5 LIBERO performance: 97.0 Spatial, 99.0 Object, 98.0 Goal, 96.0 Long, 97.5 average, versus 96.85 average for OpenPI.

source.label: LeRobot LIBERO docs, Reproducing published results

claims.summary: An outside user first measured 71.75% average with a non-documented evaluation setup. After setting policy.n_action_steps=10 as the docs specify, they reported 96.75% average, close to the claimed 97.5%. This is one independent run using the same LeRobot evaluation harness, so it confirms the documented recipe works, not that results transfer to other simulators or hardware. The setting matters a lot, so check it when comparing numbers.

evidence.label: huggingface/lerobot issue #2114: 71.75% then 96.75% after documented n_action_steps=10

claims.checked_by: Claim Ledger agent, reviewed against the cited pages

claims.title: LeRobot Pi0 LIBERO checkpoint matches reported success rates
claims.claim: lerobot/pi0_libero_finetuned achieves the LIBERO success rates listed in the LeRobot leaderboard and the original repository.

source.label: Claim as described in huggingface/lerobot issue #2114

claims.summary: An outside user measured 64.75% average (Spatial 69, Object 72, Goal 83, Long 35) and, after changing MuJoCo version and seed, 71%. They described this as 10 to 20 points under the reported figures. A LeRobot maintainer replied in the thread that the Pi0 checkpoint needs more training to reach paper-level results. The reported numbers were not independently checked by this ledger. Status means a third-party attempt did not match and the maintainers acknowledged a gap, not that anyone misreported.

evidence.label: huggingface/lerobot issue #2114: 64.75% then 71%, maintainer comment on needing more training
